decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - 1. The outbuilding, by reason of its excessive size, bulk, position and 	appearance constitutes an obtrusive feature which is out of character with the surrounding area and the St. Stephen' Conservation Area and harms the living conditions of neighbouring properties through loss of outlook. It is therefore contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.

Condition : 2 - 2. The replacement front boundary wall, by reason of its appearance would constitute an obtrusive feature which is out of character with the surrounding area and the St. Stephen' Conservation Area. It is therefore contrary to Policies ENV B.1.1 (New Development), ENV B.2.2 (Conservation Areas) and H.6.4 (Extensions and Alterations) of the Unitary Development Plan and the Residential Extension Guidelines.
description: Retention of detached single storey shed to rear of house and alterations to front garden wall.
